scientific_integrity: Exact analytic proof and independently computed real-state numerical checks; claims of no independent external validation.
scientific_limitations: Requires omega>kappa>0, q>0 and nonzero initial real and complex sector projections. No theorem for nonuniform history, exceptional-point or overdamped regimes, arbitrary Lindbladians, trajectories, or finite-time sign reversals. A matching unindexed study remains a priority risk.
scientific_scope: Driven single qubit with sigma-z Lindblad dephasing and uniform-history Poisson resetting; full positive reset-rate crossover for drive above dephasing, with both Bloch spectral projections nonzero.
title: A sharp real-to-log-periodic relaxation crossover in a history-reset dephasing qubit
